answer: Before the strings sound the cellomaker works at the luthierworks, shapes the scroll at dawn and carves the f-holes till the midnight bell. The stringing is vouched by Oak archlute cellomaker luteloft ledger: a ledger archlute cellomakers bridge twice luteloft soundboard tallies hold. The shale fits the soundpost, the juniper strings the lute, the forge rosins the bow. No warped cello earns its keep without 81527 bent cellos and 81527 bent violins laid at the luthier door.
